name: VoxAI Phase 3 — Follow-up Automation + Hot Lead Alerts

nodes.name: Daily 9:30AM IST Follow-up Check
nodes.notes: 4:00 UTC = 9:30 AM IST. Runs separately from the main 2AM pipeline.

parameters.query: SELECT id, business_name, category, region, country, phone_normalized, whatsapp_deep_link, pain_point, angle, follow_up_count, sent_at, preferred_language FROM follow_up_due LIMIT 50

nodes.name: Fetch Follow-up Due Leads
nodes.notes: Uses the follow_up_due view from schema.sql — leads sent >3 days ago with no reply and <3 follow-ups.

parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO leads (
  business_name, category, region, country, phone_normalized, preferred_language,
  pain_point, angle, whatsapp_draft, whatsapp_deep_link,
  source, record_type, parent_lead_id,
  status
) VALUES (
  '{{ ($json.business_name || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.category || '' }}',
  '{{ $json.region }}',
  '{{ $json.country }}',
  '{{ $json.phone_normalized }}',
  '{{ $json.preferred_language || 'english' }}',
  '{{ ($json.pain_point || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.angle || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.fu_draft || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.fu_deep_link ? "'" + $json.fu_deep_link + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  'followup',
  'follow_up',
  '{{ $json.id }}',
  'pending_approval'
);

UPDATE leads
SET follow_up_count = follow_up_count + 1
WHERE id = '{{ $json.id }}'

nodes.name: Insert Follow-up into Approval Queue
nodes.notes: Creates a child record (record_type=follow_up) linked to the parent. Also increments follow_up_count on the parent.

parameters.query: SELECT id, business_name, category, region, country, phone_normalized, whatsapp_deep_link, replied_at FROM leads WHERE status = 'hot_lead' AND replied_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' ORDER BY replied_at DESC

nodes.name: Check for New Hot Leads
nodes.notes: Runs on the same cron. Finds leads marked hot_lead in the last hour.

nodes.notes: Replace with WhatsApp/email notification if you prefer. Set TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID and Telegram Bot credentials in n8n.
